Name: Yandere Sabrina
Author: VileBeggar
Description:
Note: This is a merged modification of [b]Isalamiii's[/b] Yandere Sebastian mods. Full credit to her, I just did the busy work required to reflect the changes from Combined Girl Mod or Invatorzen's dialogue changes. She has given me her blessing to post this modification on the nexus. 

The original version of Yandere Sebastian can be found:[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5064?tab=description] here[/url][/b]

[u][center][size=4]WHAT THIS MOD DOES[/size][/center][/u]
[size=3]
Turns Sabrina into a yandere who is obsessed with you! Includes over 200 lines of pre-/post-marriage yandere/flirty dialogue, with festival dialogue! Sabrina's friends and people in her age group will now comment on her odd behavior. (Agibail, Sam, Maru, Alex, Haley) This happens during the entire month of summer.[/size]

[size=3]New dialogue does not appear until you are at least 2 hearts with Sabrina. I recommend trying to get to at least 2-4 hearts with her by the end of Spring for the Summer dialogue from Agibail, Sam, Maru, Alex, and Haley.
[/size]

[size=4][u]HOW TO INSTALL

[/u][/size][size=3]* Install both [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b]
* Extract/Open the file with either Winrar or 7zip.
* Copy the folder and paste it into your Mods folder, NOT the Content Patcher folder.
* And you're done!
[/size]
[u][size=4]USE[/size][/u]
[size=3]*Refer to Isalamiii's permissions on the original Yandere Sebastian mod page. 


[/size][size=4][u][center]COMPATIBILITY[/center][/u]
[/size]
[size=3]The dialogue mod loaded last will take priority for the coded dialogue slots. I personally use this mod with Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion Alternate Bachelorettes without any issues.[/size]

[u][size=4]CREDIT[/size][/u]
Once again, full credit to Isalamiii for her work on the original mod. I also want to thank gizzymo for their easy to understand file formatting from the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion [/url]. Without gizzymo's file structuring as my reference, I doubt I could have merged the two Yandere mods as fast as I did.
